NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR
TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT APPLICATION
FROM M1-2 TO C1-2
Honeysuckle Home, Inc. (THE “APPLICANT”)
4017 W Ogden Avenue

The Applicant seeks approval for a Type 1 zoning amendment from the current M1-2
designation to a Cl-2 district to allow the operation of an existing two-story brick building that is
3,938 square feet with three (3) parking spaces as a transitional residence facility. The facility
will consist of transitional housing for a maximum of ten (10) children at a time. The zoning
approval will facilitate the Applicant’s mission to provide a transitional residence for children
with chronic and acute care needs who are transitioning from a hospital to their foster care
provider.

A) Lot Area: 3,947 square feet (Recorded Measurement)
Base F.A.R.: 2.2
Approximate Building Area: 3,938 square feet
B) Bulk and Density Requirements: (MLA) = N/A (No Residential)
C) Parking: On-Site Accessory Parking: 3 spaces
Loading Spaces: 0
Bike Parking: 0
D) Building Height: Approximately 30 feet
E) Setbacks:
Front: 0”
Side: E. 0”
W. 3’
Rear: 37’.5”

TSL: Although no parking is required for a group living use of this size, the subject
property is a Transit Served Location based on proximity to CTA line at Pulaski Road (825 feet).
